== English Coruscant comparison ==
The 2013 red Effect slip uses “Plays” and omits Alter immunity. The current D-E1 card restores the printed deployment wording and Alter immunity. Both replacements carry the Grabber icon. The contemporaneous blue Defensive Shield is a separate card.
